_comment: GOLDEN CASES — operator-authored ground truth for swap_move_inner. PROPOSED (not yet frozen). Once frozen, editing requires SPEC: tag + operator action per AUTONOMY_CHARTER §12. These pin the atomicity and cap-math invariants that swap_move depends on. Each case asserts the exact events emitted (adjacent ids, shared ts) and the resulting active counts.

cases.name: happy path: A full, swap incoming inbox item with last A item, demote to B
cases.description: Fill A to 5 active. Create inbox item. swap_move(incoming -> A, last A -> B). Two ITEM_MOVED events with adjacent ids + shared ts. A active count unchanged (5), B +1 (1).

cases.name: happy path: B full, swap incoming inbox item with last B item, demote to C
cases.description: Fill B to 12 active. Create inbox item. swap_move(incoming -> B, last B -> C). B active unchanged (12), C +1.

cases.name: rejects when target tier not at cap (NO_SWAP_NEEDED)
cases.description: A has only 4 active (under cap). swap_move into A must refuse with NO_SWAP_NEEDED — swap is only meaningful at cap.

cases.name: rejects when leaving_dest also at cap (CAP_EXCEEDED: leaving_dest)
cases.description: A full (5), B full (12). swap_move into A, demoting to B must refuse with CAP_EXCEEDED: leaving_dest. v1 doesn't cascade.

cases.name: rejects self-swap (leaving == entering)
cases.description: swap_move where leaving_id == entering_id must refuse. An item can't be both the demoted and the incoming.

cases.name: blocked item in target tier excluded from active count
cases.description: A has 4 active + 1 blocked (5 total, but active count 4). swap_move into A is NOT triggered (active < cap). The blocked item doesn't count.
